t: What he told a man whose pain was destroying him
a: اجْعَلْ يَدَكَ الْيُمْنَى عَلَيْهِ وَقُلْ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَعُوذُ بِعِزَّةِ اللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ
p: Bismi-Llāh. Aʿūdhu bi-ʿizzati-Llāhi wa qudratihi min sharri mā ajidu wa uḥādhir
m: In the name of Allah. I seek refuge in the might of Allah and His power from the evil of what I feel and what I fear.
